limitations: Disproves only the uniform N^{3/2-1/12} bound with absolute C; does not rule out weaker exponents, p-dependent constants, or restricted plane families. Exact enumeration covers s=2,3; large-s divergence is analytic.
provenance: Independent SCOPE audit of TARGET disproof; construction and script from research inputs, verified by re-execution and literature comparison.
record_title: Disproof of the prime-field Cartesian-grid N^{3/2-1/12} point-plane bound via small-normal planes
